title: eranthemum pulchellum var. roseum
intro: Eranthemum pulchellum var. roseum, commonly known as Rosy Coralbell, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, aiding in the treatment of various conditions such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Eranthemum pulchellum var. roseum include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-spasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, helping to relieve respiratory and gastrointestinal symptoms. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
